**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear description of what the project bottleneck or missing game loop element is (e.g., "I find the default brick spacing makes level layout generation tedious...").

**Describe the Solution You'd Like**
A concise outline of the features or code modules you would like added to the engine environment.

**Describe Alternatives You've Considered**
Briefly note any alternative configurations or GDScript architectures you have explored.

**Additional Context**
Add any other gameplay descriptions, mockups, or Gitmoji tags relevant to the feature request layout here.
